description: The handler throws: the SDK answers 500 {"error":"handler error"} and reports the thrown value as a non-fatal error event; the tunnel status does not change. MCPWARP.md §4 status table
in:
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
mcp-session-id: abc
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 40

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
out:
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 25

{"error":"handler error"}
notes: A handler that returns something that is not a response gets the same 500. The thrown message never appears in the response body.
